findings.title: Flex layout disables the small-action button's right float
findings.body: `.small-action` is now a flex container, so its direct child action button is a flex item and the existing `float: right` on line 309 has no effect. The topic-post small-action markup places this button after `.small-action-desc`, leaving it immediately after the description instead of at the right edge as before. Give the button an appropriate flex alignment rule (for example `margin-left: auto`) or otherwise preserve the previous placement.

findings.title: Header panel has no usable non-modern-flex fallback
findings.body: This removes the panel's `float: right` and relies on `margin-left: auto` to push it to the end of the flex row. In browsers without flexbox support, including IE9, the panel becomes a normal block instead of remaining right-aligned. The included legacy `-webkit-box`/`-moz-box` modes also do not implement modern flex auto main-axis margins, so those browsers place the panel directly after the title rather than at the right edge. Retain a fallback layout or use legacy-flex-compatible positioning if those prefixed modes are intended to be supported.
